account: Bradford reports that its Annie adult-social-care assistant answers questions on the web and WhatsApp, including outside contact-center hours and in multiple languages. Since its October 2025 launch, the council reports about 50 conversations weekly, 20% outside office hours, and 74% satisfaction from follow-up feedback. The public account does not give the feedback denominator, response rate, or underlying conversation logs. Contact-center staff also use Annie to find resources. The council reports that human monitoring of conversations helped identify people who needed food or electricity and led to food parcels, without publishing case counts or individual outcomes. Equivalence to one full-time adviser is the council’s estimate, without a published calculation or demonstrated staffing reduction. A planned 20% shift of information queries to Annie is a target. These are original claims from the deploying council, without independent outcome evaluation.

ai_role.statement: Annie retrieves and combines information from trusted service resources, asks clarifying questions, and supports multilingual conversations. The reported access and usage gains are attributed to the assistant, while improved care outcomes are not established.

fields.account: Bradford reports that its Annie adult-social-care assistant answers questions on the web and WhatsApp, including outside contact-center hours and in multiple languages. Since its October 2025 launch, the council reports about 50 conversations weekly, 20% outside office hours, and 74% satisfaction from follow-up feedback. The public account does not give the feedback denominator, response rate, or underlying conversation logs. Contact-center staff also use Annie to find resources. The council reports that human monitoring of conversations helped identify people who needed food or electricity and led to food parcels, without publishing case counts or individual outcomes. Equivalence to one full-time adviser is the council’s estimate, without a published calculation or demonstrated staffing reduction. A planned 20% shift of information queries to Annie is a target. These are original claims from the deploying council, without independent outcome evaluation.
